title: OpenClaw Windows installation preflight
description: Read-only preflight for installing OpenClaw on the Windows host through 3EN-Agent. Detect supported Node.js runtime, npm, Git, package managers, PATH, npm global prefix, existing OpenClaw installation/config, Ollama presence/models/port, relevant listening ports and free disk space. No software is installed, upgraded, removed or configured.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\018a' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-018a-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; $envSnapshot=Join-Path $BackupRoot 'environment-before.txt'; @('PATH='+$env:PATH,'USERPROFILE='+$env:USERPROFILE,'LOCALAPPDATA='+$env:LOCALAPPDATA,'APPDATA='+$env:APPDATA) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $envSnapshot -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_018A_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'openclaw-preflight-018a.txt'; $out=New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]; function A([string]$s){$out.Add($s); Write-Host $s}; function Cmd([string]$name){Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; A '=== OPENCLAW WINDOWS PREFLIGHT 018A ==='; A ('TIMESTAMP='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('o'))); A ('COMPUTER='+$env:COMPUTERNAME); A ('USER='+$env:USERNAME); A ('POWERSHELL='+$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()); A ('IS_64BIT_OS='+[Environment]::Is64BitOperatingSystem); A ('IS_64BIT_PROCESS='+[Environment]::Is64BitProcess); A ''; A '=== NODE / NPM ==='; $node=Cmd 'node'; if($node){$nv=(& node --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim(); A ('NODE_FOUND=TRUE'); A ('NODE_PATH='+$node.Source); A ('NODE_VERSION='+$nv); $m=[regex]::Match($nv,'v?(?<maj>\d+)\.(?<min>\d+)\.(?<pat>\d+)'); $supported=$false; if($m.Success){$maj=[int]$m.Groups['maj'].Value;$min=[int]$m.Groups['min'].Value;$pat=[int]$m.Groups['pat'].Value;if(($maj -eq 24 -and (($min -gt 16) -or ($min -eq 16 -and $pat -ge 0))) -or ($maj -ge 26 -and (($maj -gt 26) -or ($min -gt 1) -or ($min -eq 1 -and $pat -ge 0)))){$supported=$true}}; A ('NODE_OPENCLAW_SUPPORTED='+$supported)}else{A 'NODE_FOUND=FALSE';A 'NODE_OPENCLAW_SUPPORTED=FALSE'}; $npm=Cmd 'npm'; if($npm){A ('NPM_FOUND=TRUE');A ('NPM_PATH='+$npm.Source);A ('NPM_VERSION='+((& npm --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())); try{A ('NPM_PREFIX='+((& npm config get prefix 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()))}catch{A ('NPM_PREFIX_ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}else{A 'NPM_FOUND=FALSE'}; A ''; A '=== GIT ==='; $git=Cmd 'git'; if($git){A 'GIT_FOUND=TRUE';A ('GIT_PATH='+$git.Source);A ('GIT_VERSION='+((& git --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()))}else{A 'GIT_FOUND=FALSE'}; A ''; A '=== WINDOWS PACKAGE MANAGERS ==='; foreach($pm in @('winget','choco','scoop')){$c=Cmd $pm;if($c){A ($pm.ToUpper()+'_FOUND=TRUE PATH='+$c.Source); try{$v=(& $pm --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim();A ($pm.ToUpper()+'_VERSION='+$v)}catch{}}else{A ($pm.ToUpper()+'_FOUND=FALSE')}}; A ''; A '=== EXISTING OPENCLAW ==='; $oc=Cmd 'openclaw'; if($oc){A 'OPENCLAW_FOUND=TRUE';A ('OPENCLAW_PATH='+$oc.Source);try{A ('OPENCLAW_VERSION='+((& openclaw --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()))}catch{A ('OPENCLAW_VERSION_ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}else{A 'OPENCLAW_FOUND=FALSE'}; $ocPaths=@((Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.openclaw'),(Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'OpenClaw'),(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.local\bin')); foreach($p in $ocPaths){if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){$cnt=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count;A ('OPENCLAW_PATH_EXISTS='+$p+' COUNT='+$cnt)}else{A ('OPENCLAW_PATH_MISSING='+$p)}}; A ''; A '=== OLLAMA ==='; $oll=Cmd 'ollama'; if($oll){A 'OLLAMA_FOUND=TRUE';A ('OLLAMA_PATH='+$oll.Source);try{A ('OLLAMA_VERSION='+((& ollama --version 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim()))}catch{}; try{$models=@(& ollama list 2>&1);A ('OLLAMA_MODEL_LINES='+$models.Count);foreach($line in @($models | Select-Object -First 25)){A ('OLLAMA_LIST='+([string]$line))}}catch{A ('OLLAMA_LIST_ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}else{A 'OLLAMA_FOUND=FALSE'}; A ''; A '=== LISTENING PORTS ==='; $ports=@(11434,4000,8080,8081,8082,8083,11235); $listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); foreach($port in $ports){$hits=@($listeners | Where-Object LocalPort -eq $port); if($hits.Count -gt 0){$pids=@($hits | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique);A ('PORT_'+$port+'_LISTENING=TRUE PID='+($pids -join ','))}else{A ('PORT_'+$port+'_LISTENING=FALSE')}}; A ''; A '=== DISK SPACE ==='; foreach($drive in @(Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Name)){if($null -ne $drive.Free){A ('DRIVE_'+$drive.Name+'_FREE_GB='+[math]::Round($drive.Free/1GB,2)+' USED_GB='+[math]::Round($drive.Used/1GB,2))}}; A ''; A '=== PATH CHECK ==='; $pathParts=@($env:PATH -split ';' | Where-Object {$_}); A ('PATH_ENTRY_COUNT='+$pathParts.Count); foreach($p in $pathParts){if($p -match '(?i)(node|npm|openclaw|\.local\bin)'){A ('PATH_RELEVANT='+$p)}}; A ''; A '=== PREFLIGHT DECISION ==='; if($oc){A 'DECISION=OPENCLAW_ALREADY_PRESENT_REVIEW_BEFORE_INSTALL'}elseif($node -and $supported -and $npm){A 'DECISION=READY_FOR_OPENCLAW_INSTALL_EXISTING_NODE'}elseif((Cmd 'winget') -or (Cmd 'choco') -or (Cmd 'scoop')){A 'DECISION=READY_FOR_INSTALLER_NODE_CAN_BE_PROVISIONED'}else{A 'DECISION=INSTALLER_PORTABLE_NODE_FALLBACK_MAY_BE_REQUIRED'}; A 'OPENCLAW_PREFLIGHT_018A=PASS'; $out | Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('REPORT='+$report)
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $report='C:\3EN-Agent\openclaw-preflight-018a.txt'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $report)){throw 'OpenClaw preflight report missing'}; $c=Get-Content -LiteralPath $report -Raw; foreach($m in @('OPENCLAW WINDOWS PREFLIGHT 018A','NODE / NPM','WINDOWS PACKAGE MANAGERS','EXISTING OPENCLAW','OLLAMA','PREFLIGHT DECISION','OPENCLAW_PREFLIGHT_018A=PASS')){if($c -notmatch [regex]::Escape($m)){throw ('Missing marker: '+$m)}}; Write-Host ('REPORT_SIZE='+(Get-Item -LiteralPath $report).Length); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_018A=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY PREFLIGHT: no software or configuration was changed; no rollback required.'
